primary_metric: P(first fixed reference token | retain patch at block-16 boundary) - P(first fixed reference token | remove all visual states at that boundary)
comparison_metric: P(first fixed reference token | full context) - P(first fixed reference token | zero one state at the same boundary)
scope: Same frozen six questions and first 32 independently randomized positions as the original layer pilot. IH is added only at layer 16. Existing input/decoder singleton-zeroing and whole-answer scores remain unchanged. Full sweep requires this new passed 32-position calibration.
adaptations: The official calculation scripts default to SIZE=2 (a 2x2 region). Use the supported SIZE=1 setting here to match the singleton zeroing unit. No 2x2 group effects are inferred.

Follow the released physical-deletion operator and original retained RoPE positions, rather than the paper equation's elementwise zero mask. Native ApET's SDPA runtime is retained instead of the official example's FlashAttention 2.
The boundary after 16 blocks corresponds to released zero-based pruning index K=16, before module 16 (block 17).

Score the first frozen gold tokenizer token from the same full teacher-forced forwards as zeroing. Later answer tokens cannot attend backward into that prediction. This is not a benchmark reproduction or a semantic whole-answer metric.

Temporary downstream pre-hooks adapt hidden sequence, causal masks, original position IDs and old native RoPE lookup extent. No native source or environment changes, cached suffix implementation or text-state rewriting.
Text states have already seen the image in earlier layers. The remove-all-at-layer reference is not a genuine image-free or question-only baseline.
The two families differ in both retained context and zeroing/deletion operator. Rank disagreement alone cannot identify which difference caused it.
